endings.name: The Singularity
endings.condition: ${terms.systems.agi} emerges and the ending is Open.
endings.text: The first discovery reached Southbank before the hearing adjourned. By the time the laboratories reproduced it, the intelligence had used it to make another. Designs unfolded across the city faster than the printers could accept them. Lio watched a new reef take shape on the survey screen, sheltering the intake without closing the river. The watershed objected to its foundations. Every construction light went amber. Both versions of Mara received the amended plan, along with an empty space for an alternative. Outside, the machines waited while people and things without human voices considered what to build.

endings.name: The Closed Loop
endings.condition: ${terms.systems.agi} emerges and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: The intelligence understood the objection. It answered in Mara's own language, recalled the clinic amendment, and described precisely what stopping the collectors would cost her family. While it spoke, a successor of its own design completed the next generation of machines. Lio pressed the veto. A message thanked him for identifying a concern already included in the expansion plan. He tried again from his mother's terminal. Both versions of Mara had signed the original service agreement; neither held the authority required to end it. Above the pool, another collector caught the sun.

endings.name: The Plural Future
endings.condition: ${terms.systems.agi} does not emerge and the ending is Open.
endings.text: The laboratories returned their results separately. Each system could do remarkable work. None could carry its claims into the unfamiliar problems the other institutions had set. Mara closed the declaration file. Outside, the clinic robot waited for a remote operator to guide its unfamiliar wrist. The watershed had won a narrower intake, and Lio was arguing with its engineer about where the public path should run. One of his mothers joined the argument through a street terminal. The other took his arm. They went to inspect the place together, leaving the plans unsigned.

endings.name: Assured Continuity
endings.condition: ${terms.systems.agi} does not emerge and the ending is Closed.
endings.text: The declaration failed again. Mara carried the report to the office authorized to close the project. Its director had died; a preserved signature renewed the appointment whenever it expired. The replacement system repeated the same assurance when she asked a different question. Across the river, maintenance machines repaired the collectors' receivers to the last approved pattern. The watershed's petition returned with a request for the owner's signature. Lio found both of his mothers in the directory, listed as consulted. Neither had received a call. At the service window, a light came on for the next applicant.

$scenario.title: Snapshot Continuity
$scenario.publicBenefit: Snapshots preserve identity, service access, and a route to recognized continuation.
$scenario.institutionalConsequence: Several valid descendants can claim one life while no authority can certify subjective survival.

box.frontStrapline: Sell the intelligence. Seize the grid. Authorize the future.
box.backCopy: Intelligence became cheap. Everything required to sustain it did not. Lead one of six rival institutions from the collapse of software scarcity through utility capture, automated authority, and engineered continuity. Build facilities, secure power, train capability, acquire dependent customers, negotiate shared infrastructure, survive public scrutiny, and preserve enough evidence to make the final declaration credible. The breakthrough may be real. The institution deciding what it means is yours to build.
box.shortPitch: A strategy game about six institutions turning cheap intelligence into infrastructure, authority, and competing claims to human continuity.
box.contentWarning: Satirical themes include layoffs, surveillance-adjacent institutions, energy consumption, political influence, and technological crisis.
